name: femme fatale
source:
The protagonist, Yagami Shinobu, continues his detective work in Tokyo, but returns home to settle his deceased father's estate. There, he meets with a local police inspector and learns about a case at a boarding school for foreigners. A girl living at the dormitory died under suspicious circumstances, but due to the involvement of foreigners, the investigation is stalled. Although reluctant at first, Yagami eventually decides to investigate, considering his ties to the town and its inhabitants. However, as he delves deeper into the case, he realizes he's becoming entangled in something far more complex than he initially thought.

[MTL from [url=https://www.getchu.com/sp/soft.phtml?id=5260]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公八神忍继续在东京从事侦探工作，却为了处理亡父遗产回到故乡。在那里，他遇到当地警察督察，并得知一所外国人寄宿学校发生了案件。一名住在宿舍的女孩死因可疑，但由于牵涉外国人，调查陷入停滞。八神起初并不情愿，最终仍考虑到自己与小镇及居民的联系，决定展开调查。然而，随着调查深入，他意识到自己卷入的事情远比最初想象的复杂。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/sp/soft.phtml?id=5260]Getchu[/url]]
